name: RC car wheel 12mm hex hub nut (customizer-enabled)

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a hexagonal wheel hub adapter, commonly used in RC cars. The main body is a thick hexagonal nut with a circular hole running through the center. One flat end features a rectangular pin-slot cutout running across the face, while the opposite side transitions into a curved, beveled circular collar.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric 12mm hexagonal wheel hub nut with an integrated axle pin slot. The script should allow customization of the hex size, hex height, axle hole diameter, and the pin slot's depth, width, and length.
captions.factory: The design uses a union of two main parts: a hexagonal body and a curved collar. The main hex body is generated using the MCAD library's hexagon module, from which a rectangular slot is subtracted using a translated cube and a rotated cylinder to round the slot's edges. The collar is created using a cylinder subtracted by the difference of two concentric hexagons to shape its outer bevel. Finally, a central cylinder is subtracted from the entire assembly to form the axle hole.
